scope: Non-human source, filesystem, Composer and Git requirements from the 47-item pre-audit inventory; includes prior validated requirements for regression review and three payment requirements retained as genuine human scope.
not_claimed: This targeted automation review does not approve the complete 687-item standards inventory or its human evidence obligations.

records.automated_scope: Unix other-write bit is absent throughout traversed deployment entries.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: ACLs and actual PHP process privileges are outside this predicate. Symlink targets are deliberately unassessed and produce collection diagnostics.
records.client_action: Inspect the reported exact path and owner; remove only inappropriate other-write permission. Resolve unreadable or symlink paths before claiming coverage.

records.automated_scope: env.php permission bits are a subset of 0640 and UID/GID equal configured owner/group references.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Matching project-root ownership is a deployment policy, not universal Magento security truth. Custom shared group ownership may differ legitimately. ACL restrictions are not assessed.
records.client_action: Inspect only app/etc/env.php and configured ownership references. Configure legitimate reference paths rather than recursively chown/chmod the application.

records.automated_scope: Forbidden artifact basenames are absent throughout readable pub tree, following resolvable project-contained symlinks.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: External or unresolved symlinks cannot be silently clean. This does not establish live HTTP reachability or arbitrary backup formats.
records.client_action: Remove the identified artifact from pub; inspect external links and restore traversal/read permission for exact incomplete paths.

records.automated_scope: No configured direct superglobal T_VARIABLE tokens in valid PHP under app.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Dynamic variable references and broader input-validation correctness are outside scope. Syntax/read/link gaps cannot pass; comments and literal strings are ignored.
records.client_action: Use Magento request abstractions at reported file/line. Resolve parse or read failures separately, without treating them as vulnerabilities.

records.automated_scope: No literal insecure HTTP subresource or form-action references in selected markup/CSS.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Dynamic JS URLs and live responses are outside scope. No eligible readable source is a collection limitation rather than proof of secure assets.
records.client_action: Replace the reported literal with the correct HTTPS resource. Supply readable markup/CSS source or assess the runtime response separately.

records.automated_scope: At least one readable generated PHP artifact exists in each configured generated directory.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Prior countPhpFiles counted unreadable PHP as readable artifacts, producing false PASS. Fixed. Presence does not prove freshness or compilation correctness.
records.client_action: Generate DI artifacts during the deployment build. If artifacts exist but cannot be read, grant scanner read access to the exact generated subtree.

records.automated_scope: At least one nonempty readable published frontend/admin static artifact is present.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Presence is existential, so some unrelated unreadable artifacts need not invalidate an observed readable artifact. This is not every theme/locale completeness.
records.client_action: Publish static assets during deployment; inspect the configured static directory and permissions when nothing readable is observed.

records.automated_scope: Collected app/etc/env.php cache_types.full_page is explicitly enabled.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Declared cache type state does not prove functioning cache backend, hit ratio, Varnish gateway or all runtime routes. Missing/malformed deployed state is a collection limitation, not automatically disabled cache.
records.client_action: If explicitly disabled, enable the Full Page Cache type through the deployed Magento configuration workflow. If state is absent, collect Magento cache:status or the persisted readable deployment state.

records.automated_scope: Automate against recorded Magento indexer_state, not optional var/.indexer_status file.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: The old optional file is not an authoritative runtime source, can be stale, and does not prove backlog absence. Runtime team implements real read-only DB assessment.
records.client_action: Use the deployed DB connection with SELECT permission. Inspect invalid/working indexers and schedule safe reindexing according to operational context.

records.automated_scope: Configured log/report paths or their corresponding project symlink targets are absent from collected pub.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Physical placement does not establish actual HTTP exposure. Traversal gaps and unresolved links cannot prove absence.
records.client_action: Move the identified log/report location outside pub or remove its public link. Resolve exact unreadable/link gaps separately.

records.automated_scope: Applicable advisory matches are absent in the successfully queried configured dataset for collected lock versions.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Cannot establish absence of unknown vulnerabilities or uncollected runtime dependencies. Invalid lock records or malformed API replies cannot pass.
records.client_action: Update reported package through a controlled Composer change; verify advisory-specific patch evidence. For transport failure, verify endpoint/trust/network without disabling certificate validation.

records.automated_scope: Collected Magento product branch is current or required patches have verified local alternatives.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Only collected Composer version and supported patch response are evaluated; runtime installation and unknown branches are not inferred.
records.client_action: Apply the stated Adobe security release or verify patch evidence in the collected files. Resolve unsupported branch separately from a service/network collection error.

records.automated_scope: Collected transitive lock versions have no returned applicable advisory matches.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Classification depends on valid root manifest and complete lock inventory; advisory dataset scope remains explicit.
records.client_action: Update the vulnerable dependency or requiring parent named in evidence; repair malformed manifest/lock or service connectivity separately.

records.automated_scope: Combined declared constraints intersect versions at or above a returned advisory published fixed version.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: This is not full dependency solver feasibility, platform compatibility, or every fixed branch. No-fix advisories do not prove a blocked update.
records.client_action: Adjust the reported root/parent constraint in a controlled dependency update; separately confirm Composer solver and platform compatibility.

records.automated_scope: Every requested installed version has explicit matching non-yanked status.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: An empty, partial, unknown, or wrong-version service response cannot pass. Positive withdrawn versions remain failures despite other coverage gaps.
records.client_action: Replace the specifically withdrawn version. If status is missing, verify service coverage for that package/version rather than deleting or upgrading blindly.

records.automated_scope: Affected returned advisory publication age does not exceed configured threshold.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Publication age is not organization discovery time or measured remediation SLA; missing or future publication timestamps cannot pass.
records.client_action: Review the identified affected advisory and update/patch dependency. Request corrected publication metadata when service data is incomplete.

records.automated_scope: No queried dependency has authoritative known abandoned status.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: The duplicated library-subset obligation is redundant but does not duplicate findings. Unknown status must not mean maintained. Abandonment is maintenance policy, not exploitability.
records.client_action: Migrate the named abandoned package to its reported maintained replacement, after compatibility review. Resolve unknown service classification separately.

records.automated_scope: Every queried package has known latest release time within configured calendar-month threshold.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Missing response previously referenced undefined variables and could yield false PASS. Unavailable history was silently excluded. Fixed; future dates rejected. Old age is maintenance policy, not a vulnerability.
records.client_action: Inspect the named package release history and maintenance need. Missing classification requires service metadata coverage, not an automatic upgrade of every dependency.

records.automated_scope: Every applicable source repository is explicitly assessed and is not archived, disabled, or missing.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Prior partial response could pass when any repository was active. Strict scope now rejects partial coverage, missing boolean flags, and unsupported providers. Explicit repository_not_applicable remains excluded.
records.client_action: Inspect the specific upstream repository and choose a maintained successor if needed. Ask the status service to collect unsupported/unassessed providers; do not infer archive from transport failure.

records.automated_scope: Configured root dependency sections contain no wildcard constraints.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Exact source constraint policy is not proof of insecure dependencies. Project-local manifest prevents unrelated CLI package metadata substituting for target.
records.client_action: Replace only the reported wildcard with a compatible maintained constraint and regenerate/test lock deliberately.

records.automated_scope: Configured root dependency sections contain no development branch constraints.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Root-manifest policy does not cover every transitive lock branch; development constraints may be intentional nonproduction exceptions.
records.client_action: Choose a stable compatible package version or document scope-specific development exception; do not label every dev dependency an exploitable flaw.

records.automated_scope: Target composer.json has boolean prefer-stable=true.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Missing prefer-stable may legitimately retain Composer defaults; it violates this declared project policy only, not a vulnerability by itself.
records.client_action: Set prefer-stable=true if adopting the policy and validate dependency resolution; ensure the reported target manifest is readable and valid JSON.

records.automated_scope: Collected direct lock versions match reported latest stable versions.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Latest version is maintenance policy; major upgrades may intentionally be constrained. Unknown or unparsable reported versions cannot mean current.
records.client_action: Review reported direct package latest version and compatibility before updating. Do not force major updates from security severity alone.

records.automated_scope: Composer content-hash and dependency identities/provider coverage are consistent.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: This does not prove full solver result or installed vendor integrity. Missing lock violates lock policy; existing unreadable lock previously failed as invalid JSON and is now a separate collection error.
records.client_action: Regenerate and review composer.lock in a controlled build using the target manifest. Grant read access if collector cannot access existing files; never silently regenerate production files.

records.automated_scope: Configured PCRE patterns have no eligible working-tree or local-ref history line matches.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: History previously used POSIX ERE while working tree used PCRE, silently missing custom digit patterns. Changed to git grep -P. Multiline history matching remains outside line-based scope; missing Git metadata remains incomplete.
records.client_action: Inspect reported commit/path with redacted evidence, rotate a real credential if confirmed, then apply deliberate history cleanup. Deployment scans without Git should use MB-0730.

records.automated_scope: Source schema/SQL/write patterns can support a real database assessment.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Pattern scans cannot establish actual database contents, encrypted storage, runtime paths, or legitimate misleading field names. Missing files must not be a confirmed security finding.
records.client_action: Inspect flagged schema/write sites and actual relevant database storage using masked evidence; keep broad requirement human-reviewed until authoritative storage evidence exists.

records.automated_scope: Luhn-valid PAN-like and sensitive field patterns can support a file assessment.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Patterns can match test data or unrelated identifiers; unreadable/large/omitted file scope cannot establish card-free storage. Raw PAN/CVV snippets were exposed in structured evidence; fixed redaction.
records.client_action: Inspect the specific flagged export/backup/log with masked evidence; determine actual card data and storage policy. Do not copy full PAN/CVV into scan reports or tickets.

records.automated_scope: Checkout source form/POST patterns can identify candidate raw-card handling.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Static field names and checkout keywords do not prove actual runtime collection, gateway tokenization, or hosted-field behavior.
records.client_action: Trace the flagged checkout input to server/gateway handling and verify hosted/tokenized collection with masked evidence; retain human scope for this broad requirement.

records.automated_scope: Configured secret patterns are absent in readable nonbinary deployed files within configured paths/exclusions.
records.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Patterns do not certify every secret format, excluded runtime env.php, binary files, or Git history. Oversized/unreadable files cannot pass under strict deployment coverage.
records.client_action: Inspect reported path with redacted evidence and rotate a confirmed credential. Resolve exact read/size coverage gaps or explicitly define exclusions before claiming a clean bounded scan.
